pieces.title: The Menu, Week 4
pieces.dek: Refreshed after Friday's injury report: C.J. Stroud is QB12, Puka Nacua WR11, Dontayvion Wicks WR33 with DeVonta Smith out, and the questionable Ladd McConkey and Terry McLaurin slide into the flex range.

pieces.title: Prep Notes, Week 4
pieces.dek: Jadarian Price is out, so Emanuel Wilson takes the Seattle backfield with George Holani; Keenan Allen missed Friday's practice and is a true London decision.

pieces.title: On the Line, Week 4
pieces.dek: Jeremiyah Love is RB11 after one game as the lead, Omarion Hampton is a sit at RB27 on his usage, and Braelon Allen is an RB2 with Breece Hall out.

pieces.title: Butcher Shop, Week 4
pieces.dek: Chris Olave has 36 targets and one touchdown. That price will not last, so go get him today.

pieces.title: Heat Check, Week 4
pieces.dek: Rashee Rice went from 2 targets to 6 to 9. The Kansas City passing game is his again.

pieces.title: Market Run, Week 4
pieces.dek: Ollie Gordon II took 84 percent of Miami's snaps after Achane's ACL, and he is the first name on this week's list.
